correctness.rationale: Thomson energy minimization proves the general two-ground trace identity, then exact resistance sums and five exhaustive pair-orbit calculations yield five verifiable rational identities. Two orbits are strictly dominated, and the three remaining sign polynomials prove ordered positive thresholds and exactly the claimed ties for every integer r>=2 and all finite positive gains. SymPy independently evaluates all symbolic differences and exact-rational full-matrix traces for r=2..9 and six positive gains; finite computations corroborate but do not prove universal quantifiers.
